11.description: Saskatoon approved an amendment to the Rosewood Neighbourhood Concept Plan for Parcel V, allowing a local road and lane for future mixed low to medium density residential development. This will slightly reduce the estimated population.

chips.text: Developer explained shift to individual backyards and varied housing types.
Future residents of Rosewood Parcel V will see varied housing options.
Exact number of units or population reduction was not provided.

12.description: Saskatoon approved a daycare center for up to 40 children and 5 staff at 2610 14th Street East, requiring the applicant to relocate two power poles for on-site parking.

chips.text: Applicant clarified the back alley is one-way for drop-offs and pick-ups.
Residents within 150 meters of 2610 14th Street East.
Four responses raised concerns about lane use, parking, and traffic impacts.
Applicant committed to keeping the back alley clean with a private contractor.

9.description: Several land use and rezoning applications for car washes, commercial schools, and neighborhood developments across Saskatoon were unanimously approved.

chips.text: Residents and businesses in Wildwood, Stonebridge, and Rosewood neighborhoods.
